rule_text: If mobile data is not working, first check that Mobile Data is turned ON and Airplane Mode is turned OFF.
Verify that the APN settings match the recommended configuration for the customer plan.
Restart the device: restarting the phone refreshes the network connection and often resolves the issue.
Reseat the SIM card: turn the device off, remove and reinsert the SIM card, turn it back on, then set up the APN again.

subcategory: Mobile data not working — after steps
rule_text: If APN settings are already correct and mobile data is still unavailable, the issue needs further verification: hand over to customer support.

If a device cannot connect to the pocket WiFi: (1) restart the pocket WiFi (off, wait 30 seconds, on), (2) restart the phone/tablet/computer and reconnect, (3) confirm WiFi is enabled and the correct SSID is selected, (4) re-enter the WiFi password, (5) move closer to the pocket WiFi for a stronger signal.
To reset a pocket WiFi: QUICK MENU > SETTINGS > MAINTENANCE > INITIALIZE, wait for the reset to finish, then choose English, answer YES to the usage question, and select NO in the Setup Wizard.
Pocket WiFi: hold the power button for 3 seconds to power on/off. The WiFi name (SSID) and password are in the Information Menu under WiFi.
Home WiFi devices (L-11, L-12, L-13) power on automatically when plugged into a power outlet. The WiFi name (SSID) and password are printed underneath the device.

subcategory: APN also applies to pocket WiFi
rule_text: APN configuration also applies to some pocket WiFi devices, not only to phones.

rule_text: Monthly payment can be made by SmartPit, Stripe, or GMO only.

Bank transfer (Yucho) is no longer accepted for monthly payments (since 1 December 2023). Do not recommend bank transfer. Customers who wish to change payment method can contact staff to switch from SmartPit to GMO or Stripe.

subcategory: Where to check the monthly amount
rule_text: The monthly payment amount and late payment notes are printed in the booklet the customer received with the SIM.
A late payment fee of ¥200 or ¥300 applies depending on the contract start date.

If payment is 2–5 days late, the signal is stopped. If payment is 5–7 days late after the signal stops, the line is permanently disconnected and a re-issue fee applies. Settle the account immediately to avoid disconnection.
Payment is updated 1–2 days after completion. The customer may also send a copy of the payment receipt through support so the office can update the account faster.

Yes, the signal may have stopped due to late payment. If payment is 2–5 days late after the due date, the signal will be stopped. To restore service, pay the monthly fee including the late payment fee, then inform staff after payment is confirmed so a resumption request can be made.

Late payments are accepted but a ¥300 late payment fee applies. If the customer expects to be unable to pay on time, they should contact us before the due date: a payment arrangement request may be submitted to the office, subject to approval and company policy.
Yes. The customer should contact us so we can request early registration of the bill.

If the customer will be away during the billing period, we recommend paying in advance before the trip; a temporary holiday promotion is also offered. If advance payment is not possible, contact us before the due date to check whether a payment arrangement is available, subject to company policy and approval.

subcategory: If the bill is not paid
rule_text: Failure to pay by the due date may result in a ¥300 late payment fee, temporary suspension of internet service, and additional charges if the account remains unpaid or is permanently stopped.

rule_text: If the number has been permanently disconnected, a ¥4,000 fine applies and the outstanding bill must be paid by the end of the month to avoid being blacklisted. Once all payments are made, the customer may place a new SIM/data order.

After a resumption request is made, the signal is normally reconnected within 2–4 working days.

rule_text: There are two reasons for returning items. For cancellation: return everything received with the order (SIM card / pocket WiFi, SmartPit card, etc.). For replacement or plan change: return only the item being replaced (SIM card / pocket WiFi) — do NOT send back the SmartPit card.

When returning, take photos of: (1) a clear image showing the ICCID number on the SIM card or device, and (2) the envelope being dropped into the postal box. Send the photos through our support platform so they are recorded as proof of return.
Return address: 〒103-0027, Karen Nihonbashi Building 5F, 3-8-13 Nihonbashi, Chuo-ku, Tokyo. Make sure the return envelope shows the current office address.
If the return envelope is not updated or has expired, guide the customer to the convenience-store return method instead.
Not every return qualifies for a cashback refund.
Changing to an AU50GB3D X11 or X12 device costs ¥2,000 plus a ¥700 delivery fee — ¥2,700 in total.
When a plan is changed, the customer phone number (MSN) also changes. State this clearly — it is a frequent customer question.
Correct wording: "Your old SIM card or device must be returned within 7 days." (not "your old plan").
Free replacement conditions differ between SIM card and pocket WiFi — state which applies.

rule_text: Cashback refund is processed within 8–14 business days after the returned item is received and checked at our office.

If a deposit is confirmed by staff, the customer must provide: photo of the ICCID on the SIM/pocket WiFi, proof of return, photo of the bank account or cash card, customer or SmartPit number, account number, account holder name, bank name or code, and branch name or code.

Contracts started before 7 September 2025: no claim deadline applied until 31 October 2025; from 1 November 2025 a 60-day claim period applies. Contracts started on or after 7 September 2025: a 60-day claim period applies immediately. Explain the process first, then the deadline.

For Data SIM and Pocket WiFi plans, the COD payment is refundable if the customer notifies us within 7 days of receiving the item and returns the complete item within those 7 days, together with proof of return, ICCID photo, bank account photo, customer/SmartPit number and full bank details.

A refund can be sent to an overseas bank account. Required: destination country, delivery method (bank transfer), bank name, branch code or name, account number, account name, nationality, postal code, branch address, mobile number, branch landline, personal email, email language, and a picture of the bank account or cash card.
A refund cannot be processed without returning the SIM card or pocket WiFi. The returned item must be complete and proof of shipment provided.
To check refund status the customer should contact support with their customer number or SmartPit number.
Customers who paid the ¥800 deposit must give 2 months advance notice for a cancellation request.
For cancellation requests, collect the SmartPit / GMO / customer number before handing over to staff.
